messages:
mariak: Heads-up — discovered a 'credential depot' dump in a partner S3 archive (staging-backups/2026-03-23.tar.gz). Blobs are KMS-encrypted but include vault transit ciphertext and some plain metadata. Suspect scoped svc acc keys for staging-agent. Need cleanup + KMS rewrap + RBAC lock.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-20260323-73 · priority=high · assigned=eng-security · link=https://incidents.internal/INC-20260323-73 :rotating_light:

samir: Can you paste the S3 path and the object names? are any plaintext creds visible or just ciphertext + metadata?

mariak: s3://partner-ingest/staging-backups/2026-03-23.tar.gz
objects: staging-agent/credentials.enc, staging-agent/manifest.json
metadata: owner=partner-ci, created_by=partner-hook, vault_path=secret/data/staging/agent
No plaintext in the blob, but manifest.json includes service names and older key IDs.

ops-jen: Two immediate asks: 1) add an audit sink for requests touching secret/data/staging/agent, 2) create a least-privileged KMS grant for rewrap with separate key. I can spin up a temporary grant.

tyler: Proposed triage steps (short):
- quarantine object (already done?)
- snapshot current vault state for path secret/data/staging/agent (audit + snapshot)
- create new KMS key (kms-redwood-rotor-staging) + policy limiting to rewrap/unwrap from ops subnet
- rewrap ciphertext -> new key and push new ciphertext to partner (or delete partner copy)
- rotate any active tokens / short-lived creds bound to that svc account
- RBAC: restrict read to 'ci-staging' role only

mariak: partner disabled the object ACLs; quarantine confirmed. No writes allowed. I uploaded a copy to internal quarantine bucket: s3://redwood-quarantine/3512467890/

samir: For vault snapshot, run something like:
```
vault kv get -format=json secret/data/staging/agent > /tmp/staging-agent-snapshot.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/staging-agent-snapshot.json s3://redwood-audit-buckets/snapshots/3512467890.json --sse aws:kms
```
We should avoid storing actual secret values in S3 for long — mark the object TTL 24h and restrict to sec-team-only.

mariak: snapshot uploaded to redwood-audit-buckets and TTL set to 24h. Added lifecycle rule.

aaron: I can own the KMS work and rewrap. Quick question: do we want to rotate the vault encryption key or just rewrap existing ciphertext with new KMS key? I prefer rewrap first (faster), then schedule a vault key rekey during maintenance.

ops-jen: Agree with rewrap-first. Also, add an audit policy change: enable detailed request logging for that path with request metadata forwarded to splunk for 90d. We need full visibility before and after rewrap.

tyler: RBAC changes: create a temporary deny rule for any principal outside the 'ci-staging' role for secret/data/staging/agent and deploy via casbin OR k8s policy controller (whichever is faster). Then rollback after keys are rotated and creds validated.

samir: Quick audit query to check historical reads:
```
# vault audit logs (json) -> filter reads to path
jq 'select(.type=="request" and .data.request.path=="secret/data/staging/agent")' /var/log/vault/audit.log | jq '{time: .time, accessor: .data.auth.accessor, operation: .data.request.operation}'
```
Run that and paste results here. We need to identify any unusual accessor ids.

mariak: Pasted first 6 entries — two accessors are partner-ci-consumer-1 and one unknown accessor (a6b3f). Forwarded logs to splunk and linked to the incident.

aaron: starting KMS key creation now. Will create kms-redwood-rotor-staging, policy restrict to ops subnet and to 'redwood-rewrap' IAM principal. ETA ~ 25m.

sec-bot: INC-20260323-73 update: responder=aaron, eta_kms=25m, snapshot_present=true, quarantine=true

ops-jen: Schedule a 15m sync w/partner security and oncall to hand off rewrap and confirm deletion of partner copies. I'm free in 30m — setting provisional invite and will update.

mariak: Thanks all. Checklist I'm tracking: quarantine✓, snapshot✓, audit sink✓, kms grant pending, rewrap in progress, RBAC deny ready, rotation + validate creds, partner deletion confirmation, TTL/cleanup followup. I'll update incident once rewrap completes. :white_check_mark:
